model_info.label: G1 Elo
model_info.note: Chronological team Elo with home-court adjustment and 25% offseason regression.

model_info.label: G2 Efficiency
model_info.note: Rolling pace plus opponent-adjusted offensive and defensive efficiency.

model_info.label: G3 Joint scores
model_info.note: G2 score means with a pregame bivariate residual distribution.

baselines.B0: fixed home-win rate from training seasons
baselines.B1: fixed home/away league points-per-game means from training seasons

g2.winner_probability: logistic margin scale set from prequential train residual SD

g3.distribution: bivariate normal score residuals; rounded integer scores

sources.game_crosswalk: canonical date/home/away tuple within one day, exact score pair, unique match required
sources.game_phases: SportsDataverse nba_stats_schedules; season_type identifies regular season and NBA Cup final
sources.team_boxes: SportsDataverse espn_nba_team_boxscores; one ESPN-ID team row per side

uncertainty.delta_definition: candidate metric minus comparator metric; lower is better
uncertainty.g2_crps_definition: G2 is treated as a deterministic point-mass distribution; its CRPS equals absolute error for margin and total.
uncertainty.method: Paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap; resample NBA local game_date blocks with replacement, retaining every game on each sampled date.
uncertainty.p_better_definition: share of replicates with candidate-minus-comparator delta < 0
